input.quote: 9.4 Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form without cause by delivering the written notice specified in Section 29.4. Customer owes only accrued Fees, and Vendor shall refund prepaid Fees for the period after termination.
input.rationale: Section 9.4, read with Section 29.4 (thirty days' notice), gives Customer a convenience termination right over the whole Agreement or any Order Form on 30 days' written notice, with liability limited to accrued Fees and a refund of prepaid Fees for the post-termination period (reinforced by Section 10 at p0045). There is no early-termination fee or penalty anywhere in the document, and no Vendor termination-for-convenience right — Vendor's termination rights are limited to material breach (9.1) and insolvency (9.2). This meets the preferred position in full; no redline needed.
